src.gen: A vast prison exercise yard at midday, dozens of men in grey uniforms scattered across an open concrete compound, tall fences and a watchtower in the distance
src.move: a lone man in a grey prison uniform walks steadily down the center of the yard toward the camera

src.gen: An older man in a prison warden's uniform with a radio on his belt stepping out of a brick administration building into open daylight
src.move: the warden steps through the doorway and begins walking across the yard, scanning the rows of inmates

src.gen: The warden standing face to face with an inmate in the middle of the prison yard, speaking directly to him, other inmates blurred in the background
src.move: the warden raises one hand and stops walking, turning to speak

src.gen: A close view of the warden's weathered face in the prison yard light, a thoughtful and slightly puzzled expression
src.move: the warden slowly shakes his head side to side while he talks

src.gen: The warden looking closely at an inmate standing calmly in the prison yard, studying his face for an answer
src.move: the warden tilts his head and leans in slightly, waiting

src.gen: An inmate standing still and calm in the open prison yard, a shaft of sunlight breaking through clouds behind the fence line
src.move: sunlight shifts across the yard as the man speaks, standing steady and relaxed
